feature_request: Add password validation to the login system. Require at least 10 characters, one uppercase letter, one number, and one special character. Also add tests for valid and invalid passwords.
acceptance_criteria: Reject login if the password is less than 10 characters long, displaying a specific error message for insufficient length.
Reject login if the password contains no uppercase letters, displaying a specific error message for missing uppercase letters.
Reject login if the password contains no numeric digits, displaying a specific error message for missing numbers.
Reject login if the password contains no special characters, displaying a specific error message for missing special characters.
Allow login and proceed to standard authentication if the password meets all specified character requirements.
